notes.title: Save Game Hotfix
notes.content:
Fixed bug where previous save files were becoming corrupted after playing a custom level. 

Saved games from before update V2.0 still need to be copied over manually. See pinned discussion

notes.title: UPDATE V2.0 IS HERE!
notes.content:
SlipDream Resonator Update v2.0
[list]
[h3][*]Updated Game Engine from Unreal Engine 4 to Unreal Engine 5
[*]Completely overhauled level sequencing
[*]Implemented MIDI Sequencing framework
[*]Increased sequence precision and timing accuracy
[*]Implemented ability to import Custom levels[/h3]
Users can easily create Custom levels by exporting MIDI sequences using a Digital Audio Workstation (DAW) program

README inside the ‘Custom’ folder in the game file structure has instructions on the process of creating Custom levels in detail.

Users can import custom Album Art for their custom levels
[i].jpg and .png files are accepted[/i]

Users can import custom background Video for their custom levels
[i].mp4 and .avi files are accepted[/i]
[h3][*]Implemented Global leaderboards[/h3]
Previous high scores will still apply and be uploaded to Global leaderboards
[h3][*]Updated Small Brain Games splash screen logo 
[*]Updated Tutorial[/h3]
Added ‘Arcade’ section of tutorial
Streamlined Tutorial experience. Tutorial is now optional
[h3][*]Updated info and tips[/h3]
Added new text boxes to display relevant information and tips
[h3][*]Updated Level Select[/h3]
Fixed performance issue
Fixed multiple bugs
[h3][*]NEW Level[/h3]
Keita - book report
Can be used as a example template for Custom MIDI sequences
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 3/23/23
notes.content: Fixed Arcade mapping bug from V1.2 patch

notes.title: V1.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
•	Increase in overall performance
•	Increased performance on Steamdeck
•	Added toggle option for Holographic HUD FX (default is set to off)
•	Added Arcade control option. Default setting requires a number pad. Allows for single-hand control and more options for controller mapping
•	Added Audio/Video delay calibration cue
•	Fixed bug that cancelled combos in keyboard mode
•	Fixed credits bug
